bug_report: The board crashes while printing the sensor average during start-up.

agent.root_cause: The code calls report_average() before sensors_init(), leading to division by zero because sample_count is initialized to zero by default.

initial_evidence.backtrace:
#0  HardFault_Handler () at startup.c:21
#1  <signal handler called>
#2  0x0800026a in report_average () at main.c:27
#3  0x080002b6 in main () at main.c:36

args.root_cause: The code calls report_average() before sensors_init(), leading to division by zero because sample_count is initialized to zero by default.
